Check completion of topical MAR charts and body maps. \ If topical medication is kept in the residents room check these are stored safely. \ Check the topical is annotated with the date opened and that the resident is not using another residents medication \ <w:tab w:val="left" w:pos="5565"/></w:tabs><w:spacing w:line="259" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:bCs/><w:i/><w:iCs/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r><w:rPr><w:bCs/><w:i/><w:iCs/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">If HCA’s are administering topicals have they been trained and deemed competent to do so.

<w:tab w:val="left" w:pos="5565"/></w:tabs><w:spacing w:after="160" w:line="259" w:lineRule="auto"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:lastRenderedPageBreak/><w:t>Are Controlled medications stored appropriately with robust records maintained?

<w:tab w:val="left" w:pos="5565"/></w:tabs><w:spacing w:after="160" w:line="259" w:lineRule="auto"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Are Controlled medications administered safely?
